# overall structure

Start the film with: Spring is here, and your next favourite jacket is one click away!

# voiceover

Super enthusiastic, upbeat TV-shopping host. Big energy, short punchy sentences, lots of excitement!

# background music

no music

# steps

1. open `http://localhost:4705/`
2. tick `Jackets` in the filters, then drag the max price slider down to about £130
3. open the `Trail Shell Jacket`
4. flip through the photos with the arrows and hover over the photo to show the zoom
5. before adding to cart, first pick the blue one
6. choose size `L` and add it to the cart
7. in the mini cart add one more jacket, then close it and scroll the `Customers also bought` row to the right with its arrow
8. go to checkout and fill in the demo details: name `Demo Shopper`, email `demo@example.test`, address `1 Test Street`, card `4242 4242 4242 4242`, expiry `12/30`, CVC `123`
9. place the demo order and show the confirmation
